comment: TS version matrix for the fixture harness. Each entry becomes an isolated fixture project with its own pinned TypeScript and its own installed tarball of the built packages. Every `typescript` value is an exact pin, never a dist-tag: a floating tag silently redefines what a lane measures, which is how the top lane started type-checking against the 7.x compiler without anyone choosing that. New compiler generations get their own lane instead. `packages` must list every @cancjs package that any fixture imports. A missing name does not fail loudly: resolution walks up to the hoisted workspace symlink and type-checks the working tree instead of the packed tarball, which is exactly what this harness exists to avoid. moduleResolution is chosen per version so the intended d.ts resolution path is exercised: TS<4.7 has no `exports`/`node16` support so it falls through package.json `typesVersions` to dist/types-ts4.2; TS>=4.7 reads the `exports.types@<4.7` / `types` conditions. `decoratorTypes:true` additionally materialises three extra fixture projects per version (stage-3, ts-legacy, babel-legacy audit) compiling the decorator member-type-preservation assertions against `@cancjs/decorators`; stage-3 (TC39) decorator syntax needs TS 5.0+, so only the 5.0 and newer lanes set it (4.2/4.7 reject the syntax).
peerDependenciesComment: Framework peers referenced by common/server-express-types.ts, common/server-fastify-types.ts and common/server-node-types.ts. Not @cancjs packages, so packPackages() never touches them; merged straight into every non-decorator fixture's package.json so `import ... from 'express'` / 'fastify' resolve inside the isolated node_modules, even in a lane that does not compile the fastify file (an uninstalled-but-unimported package costs nothing). Pinned to the exact versions the server packages themselves devDependency-pin, so the fixture never drifts from what the shipped .d.ts were checked against.
serverTypesComment: common/server-express-types.ts, common/server-node-types.ts and common/server-fastify-types.ts compile only in versions marked serverExpressTypes / serverFastifyTypes (server-node rides the express gate, see its file header). Neither gate is a defect in what this repo ships: express pulls in @types/node's stream/web.d.ts through @types/express-serve-static-core, which hits a real TypeScript recursive-type limitation (`ReadableByteStreamController` etc. 'referenced directly or indirectly in its own type annotation') fixed only at 5.0+, so 4.2/4.7 cannot parse it regardless of which @types/node version is installed. Fastify's own shipped .d.ts additionally needs the NoInfer utility type (TypeScript 5.4+), so it starts one lane later. See each fixture file's own header for the measured errors.
